ApiKeyView.description: Public key metadata (never includes the secret).

can_write.description: Whether the requesting user may mutate this bookmark.

owner_display_name.description: Present for invitees — owner's display name (or email local-part).

shared_out.description: Owner has shared a folder this bookmark lives in (invitees see invitee badges instead).

shared_with.description: Owner-only: invitee display labels for the outgoing share pill tooltip.

CategoryAccess.description: Effective access for the current user on a category.

CategoryPublicLinkView.description: Owner-facing public-link state for a category (list).

slug.description: Present when enabled. High-entropy unlisted slug.

last_bookmark_at.description:
When a live bookmark directly in this folder was last added or changed. Set by
`list_categories` only; the sidebar orders its recent folders by it.

owner_display_name.description: Present for invitees — owner's display name (or email local-part).

shared_out.description: True when the owner has shared this folder (or an ancestor) with someone.

shared_with.description: Owner-only: invitee display labels for the outgoing share pill tooltip.

CategoryVisibility.description:
Who can see a category's bookmarks on the owner's profile. "Public" is reserved for
the no-login Public link, so the widest tier here is `Members`.

ChangeBans.description: Changes every listed ban. Fields left out keep their value.

revoke_api_keys.description: Also revoke every API key. Other login sessions always end.

CreateAbuseReport.description: `target_id` is a public list's slug or category id, a user id, or a comment id.

CreateApiKeyResponse.description: One-shot create response: view + plaintext token (shown once).

CreateBan.description: `ends_at` or `days` sets the end. Neither means permanent.

vault_id.description: For a loose vault bookmark. Categories inside a vault imply their vault.

email.description: Optional: bind invite to this email (case-insensitive match on register).

last_opened_at.description: When the viewer last opened it.

open_count.description:
How often the viewer opened it: in the last 30 days for a section counting that
window, otherwise of all time. Absent when never opened.

DashboardOpenWindow.description: The period "Most opened" counts opens over.

DashboardSectionDisplay.description: How a section shows its bookmarks.

DashboardSectionLayout.description:
A section's place and size on the dashboard's 12-column grid, in grid units. The web app
packs sections upward, so `y` orders them more than it places them.

DashboardSectionSettings.description:
A section's type, display mode and source. Every field has a default, so older layouts
and exports (title and pins only) still read as pinned, medium sections.

DashboardSectionSource.description: Filters for a section that fills itself. A bookmark must match every one that is set.

category_id.description: A folder of the owner's, with its subfolders.

site.description: A website, such as `github.com`; its subdomains match too.

DashboardSummary.description: Lightweight row for switchers / settings (no sections).

shared_out.description: True when the owner has shared this dashboard with someone.

shared_with.description: Owner-only: invitee display labels for the outgoing share pill tooltip.

DuplicateAction.description: What to do with an imported bookmark whose URL is already in the library.

DuplicateDecisions.description: The person's choices, by index into the parsed file. Missing means `Keep` for every row.

EmailDelivery.description: How a notification kind's email arrives.

ErrorBody.description: The error body. See the module docs.

code.description: Stable machine-readable id, such as `not_found` or `quota_exceeded`.

details.description:
Extra data for some codes: `ban` for `banned`, `meter`/`limit`/`used` for
`quota_exceeded`, `blockers` for `vault_move_blocked`.

error.description: Same as `message`. Kept for older clients.

message.description: Human-readable text. Wording may change between releases; match on `code`.

FolderCounts.description: Live bookmarks per folder the person can open, and in their Unsorted.

folders.description: Direct bookmarks per folder (not counting subfolders). Folders with none are absent.

count.description: Bookmarks on the same site in this folder.

ForkCategory.description: Copy a readable category tree (+ bookmarks) into a new owned root.

duplicates.description: What to do with bookmarks already in the library. Missing: create them all, as before.

LinkCheckStatus.description: Last probe result from the broken-link checker worker.

credential.description: The browser's WebAuthn credential, as JSON.

PatchDashboard.description: Rename and/or pin. Pinning a shared dashboard needs read access and only affects the caller.

claim_token.description: Single-use claim link token. Only present in the response that created it.

PendingShareSubjectType.description: Subject for a pending (pre-account) share invite.

ProfileView.description: A user's profile as another signed-in user sees it.

PublicBookmarkView.description: Bookmark fields safe to expose on a public list (no notes / vault / owner ids).

preview_url.description:
Where anyone may load the stored preview, when `has_preview` and the caller is
anonymous. Set on public lists.

PublicListView.description: Anonymous read model for a published bookmark list.

bookmarks.description: The newest bookmarks, at most `PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT` of them.

total.description: How many bookmarks the list holds, including any left out of `bookmarks`.

PutDashboardLayout.description: Full layout replace for a personal dashboard.

bookmark_ids.description: Pins, for a pinned section. Ignored for sections that fill themselves.

credential.description: The browser's WebAuthn credential, as JSON.

bootstrap_token.description: The server's `BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN`, needed for the first account when one is set.

invite_code.description: Required when registration is closed (after bootstrap).

share_token.description: From a share invite's claim link.

terms_version.description: Terms of Service version the user accepted: the server's `TERMS_VERSION`, when it has one.

turnstile_token.description: Cloudflare Turnstile widget token; required when the server has Turnstile keys.

password.description: Required when the account has a password.
Required for accounts with a local password; ignored for single sign-on only accounts.

oneOf.description: Left out: keep how this kind is delivered now.

ShareAccess.description: Membership grant on a shared category (`read` / `write` only).

add_category_ids.description: Folders to add the bookmark to, alongside the ones it is in when the edit is saved.

add_tags.description: Tags to add to whatever the bookmark has when the edit is saved.

email.description:
Accepted only when it matches the current address. An address changes through an
emailed confirmation link, or by an instance admin.

show_keyboard_hints.description: Hide key numbers, key hint lines and shortcut keycaps. Missing means unchanged.

api_key.description: An API key (`ldk_…`) from Config options → API keys, or a sign-in session token, as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

session_cookie.description: The browser's sign-in cookie. Writes also need the `X-Linkdean-Client` header.
session_cookie.name: linkdean_session

session_token.description: A sign-in session token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. API keys are refused here.

info.description: The HTTP API behind the Linkdean web app, browser extension and integrations. Every error answers `{ code, message, details?, error }`: match on `code`, show `message`. Successful JSON reads carry an `ETag`; send it back in `If-None-Match` to get `304 Not Modified`. Every response has an `X-Request-Id` to quote in bug reports.
info.title: Linkdean API

post.summary: Sends straight away, skipping the outbox, so the admin sees the SMTP result at once.

get.summary:
What the retry button needs: how many failed screenshots a retry would take, and when it
is next allowed.

post.summary:
Queue failed screenshots for another try, at most once per cooldown. Only failures older
than the cooldown are taken, so a page that just failed is not tried again at once.
Clear Meili bookmarks index and re-upsert all non-vault, non-deleted bookmarks.

Change an account's email at once. The admin vouches for the address, so it counts as
verified.

Mark an account verified (its waiting invites attach) or remove its verification (new
invites wait; accepted shares stay).
A reset link to hand over privately; the only way back in when mail is off.

parameters.description: `zip` (default): a `<name>/` folder. `md`: the `SKILL.md` alone, every link inline.
parameters.name: format

post.summary: Login sessions only: a key that could mint keys would survive its own revocation.

Start an email change: the link goes to the new address, a notice to the old one. The
address stays the same until the link is opened.
Finish an email change with its link. No session needed.
Send a new verification link to the signed-in account's address.
Verify an address with its link. No session needed.
Login sessions only, like creating any API key: a key must never mint another.
No session: the extension proves itself with the verifier only it holds.

get.summary:
Always redirects: home with a session, the login page with a pending link or a reason, or
back to the profile page in connect mode.

post.summary:
Detach single sign-on after a password check. Accounts without a password cannot, so they
keep a way to sign in. Wrong passwords count against the sign-in limits.

get.summary:
The masked provider address of the browser's pending link, for the login prompt. 404 when
there is none or it expired or was used.

parameters.description: `oidc`, `google`, `microsoft` or `github`; the first configured one when unset.
parameters.name: provider

parameters.description: Reauth mode: `profile` returns to the profile page, anything else to settings.
parameters.name: return

get.summary:
`?mode=connect` attaches the provider identity to the signed-in account instead of signing
in; it needs a session. Sign-in may create an account, so on a server with terms it needs
`?terms_version=` equal to `TERMS_VERSION`; the flow cookie carries it to the callback, which
records it on a new account. Existing accounts sign in unchanged. Connect mode never creates an account.

post.summary: Checks the passkey's answer and signs in. Failures count against the address's sign-in limit.
Starts a passkey sign-in. Anyone may ask; it costs a row that expires in minutes.

Always answers the same, at once; the lookup and email happen in the background, so neither
the reply nor its timing says whether the address has an account.
Set the new password, end every session and sign this browser in.

get.summary: Live bookmarks per folder and in Unsorted, for Explorer's folder tiles.

The person's own bookmark at exactly this URL, if any, so quick save can open it instead
of saving a second copy. Vault bookmarks are never matched.

post.summary:
Fetches a page's title, description and keyword tags so the bookmark form can fill in
what the person has not typed yet. Nothing is saved. Counts as one enrich action and is
rate limited per user. The SPA never calls it for a bookmark headed into a vault.

get.summary: Hashes of every URL the person has saved, for the browser extension's saved-page icon.
Folders and tags the person already uses on this bookmark's site, for the filing queue.

post.summary:
Records that the signed-in person opened the bookmark, for the dashboard's Most opened
and Recently visited sections. Vault bookmarks are not recorded.

requestBody.description: A `file` field with a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

get.summary: Liveness. Reports the running version so a deploy can confirm which build is live.

post.summary:
What an import of this file would do: which bookmarks are already in the library, and
how many folders would be reused. Writes nothing.

get.summary: Liveness of dependencies (Postgres + Meilisearch). Use for Compose / k8s probes.
Where to send abuse and takedown requests that do not fit the report form.

post.summary:
Claim an invite link while signed in. The invite must be for this account's address; it
then shows up with the other invites to accept.

Schedules the account for deletion after the grace period. The session stays signed in, so
the person can still export their data and cancel.

get.summary: Which notification kinds the user also gets by email, and how, in settings order.

post.summary: Saves the passkey the browser made, and tells the account's address.
Starts adding a passkey to the signed-in account. Login sessions only, not API keys.

delete.summary: Removes a passkey. Passkeys are never an account's only way in, so no check is needed.

post.summary: Accepts the current Terms of Service, after they changed since the account last did.

Replacing the recovery key cancels the old one, so it takes the vault passphrase even
when the vault is unlocked.
